correctness.rationale: Proof explicitly identifies each line graph adjacency with exactly one original wedge and half a neighbor pair difference; coarea and linearity reduce all real input norms to cut indicators, with attainment. Each cut-edge contribution is bounded by n−2 same-side neighbors with exact equality characterization. Tree bridge cuts attain the degree-pair triangle bound. The finite exact rational checker enumerated 771 connected labelled graphs (11,199 cuts) and 145 labelled trees; unrestricted assertions rest on the proof, not enumeration.

value.rationale: The canonical local positive vertex-to-edge arithmetic lift has a sharp all-graph variation coefficient and an attained extremizer for every graph. Structural consequences separate stable paths/cycles from linearly amplifying stars/cliques, classify all nonexpansive trees, locate first amplification at five vertices, and characterize equality in the universal ceiling; positivity/endpoint stability alone cannot yield these graph-variation conclusions.
